Do not assume fixed IP, 732 metrics, OAM_4 or GPU_4 without owner mapping

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2050 Wistron-AMD SVM-01061-V003: approve the actual protected VNIC/Redfish endpoint/schema, live telemetry inventory/topology-derived count instead of assuming 732, per-metric bounds/units/nonzero exceptions, OAM/GPU memory-temperature resource map, AGFHC HBM 20-minute target/pass criteria, before/during sampling and temperature acceptance, plus thermal/power abort/recovery rules.

review_improvement: Restores root, full telemetry, exact sensor and AGFHC correlation coverage, rejects insecure/fixed assumptions, and makes limits and stress safety traceable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A bulk report count is firmware/topology-dependent and a blanket nonzero rule can falsely fail legitimate counters or status values. The sensor comparison is meaningful only when both samples refer to the same physical OAM/GPU resource with units and timestamps during a verified active HBM workload. A temperature rise supports responsiveness but does not by itself establish calibration or overall telemetry correctness, so all bounds and workload health remain separate criteria.
